title: Product Design Intern (2027 Start)
description:
(P-1594)
At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.
As a Product Design Intern, you will join a team that works diligently to understand and solve our customers' most challenging problems . You will learn how to be a successful product designer at a high-growth enterprise technology company that operates at the important intersection of data and AI. You will have a dedicated mentor and will join our 2026 intern cohort where you'll connect with product managers, engineers, designers, account teams, other interns, and leaders from across the company.
This is a 12-week paid summer internship program.
The impact you will have:
Work with a cross-functional team to build features for the Databricks platform
Manage your project end-to-end, from discovery and ideation through final design prototype for engineering to implement from
Conduct research with customers to better understand their needs and improve your design 
What we look for:
Pursuing a degree in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or Spring 2028
You have excellent interaction design skills with knowledge of user-centered design methodologies and usability.
You have a proven ability to efficiently build interactive prototypes leveraging the latest in AI tooling. 
You use analytical skills to make data-driven decisions (e.g. analyze product usage) and can conduct basic usability testing and semi-structured interviews.
You have exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex topics simple and clearly communicate nuance to partners (engineers, customers, field, etc.) in both written and verbal form
You are excited to solve ambiguous problems with a collaborative team

About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents.
